bio.text: Beth Farnham is the Democratic nominee for Pennsylvania's 13th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election, having advanced from the May 19, 2026 primary.
She served on the Conewago Valley School District school board, representing Region 2, until 2023.
According to Ballotpedia, she grew up in Maryland, lives in Conewago Township, Pennsylvania, and earned a bachelor's degree in biology from Towson University in 1996.
Her listed career experience includes work as a credit analyst and administrative assistant, and as a stay-at-home parent.
